matches.headline: A proper nervy Meadow Lane win
matches.reaction: Not perfect, but exactly the kind of match you need to survive if you want the season to mean anything. First half had proper control, second half got way too dramatic, but the limbs at full-time made it worth it.
highlights: wing play looked dangerous all night
last ten minutes were pure stress
talkingPoints: the full-backs created most of the threat
keeper made the save that changed the ending

prediction.note: expected more control than we actually got

ratings.note: worked hard and got the goal

matches.headline: A point, technically
matches.reaction: The kind of match that makes highlights editors question their life choices. Defensive shape was good, but the final third had absolutely no spark. Useful point, boring memory.
talkingPoints: needed more runners beyond the striker
a clean sheet away from home is still valuable

matches.headline: Chance to make Meadow Lane loud again
talkingPoints: start quickly and make them chase
avoid cheap fouls around the box
